zh-CN.title: 个性化改为先预览，再保存
items: 选择背景、气泡、头像框或广场人物时只更新预览，点击右上角保存后才正式生效
未解锁的候选也可以自由试览，保存时会清楚提示所需条件
预览区域会随列表保持可见，并重新梳理了时隙与声浪头像框的层次

en.title: Preview personalization before saving
items: Choosing a background, bubble, avatar frame, or plaza character now updates only the preview until Save is pressed
Locked choices remain available to try, with requirements explained only when saving
Previews stay visible while browsing, and the Portal and Soundwave frame layers have been refined
